title: Linux Netlink as an IP Services Protocol

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 3549 credits the original Netlink character device to Alan Cox and Alexey Kuznetsov with extending Netlink to the IP-service delivery model; it describes parameterization, asynchronous notification and statistics/query uses.
claims_extracted.notes: Informational retrospective by participants; not itself the Linux ABI specification.

notes: Useful participant/standards-era interpretation of the earlier implementation lineage.
